title: Authentication and reading-list CRUD with ownership

scope.summary: Email + password sign-up, sign-in and sign-out; users create, view, rename and delete their own reading lists; nobody else can read or change them.

ui.signup: GET /signup: fields labelled "Name", "Email", "Password"; button "Sign up". Success -> signed in and redirected to /lists.
ui.login: GET /login: fields labelled "Email", "Password"; button "Sign in". Success -> /lists. Failure -> stays on /login with an element role=alert containing "Invalid".
ui.shell_signed_in: When signed in, every page shows a button "Sign out" (signs out and goes to /).
ui.lists_index: GET /lists: heading "My lists"; one link per list of the signed-in user whose accessible name is the list name, pointing to /lists/{id}; a link or button "New list" to /lists/new.
ui.create: GET /lists/new: field labelled "Name"; button "Create list". Success -> /lists/{id} ({id} = one non-empty path segment).
ui.show: GET /lists/{id}: h1 = list name. For the owner: link "Edit" to /lists/{id}/edit and button "Delete list" (deletes immediately, no browser dialog, then goes to /lists).
ui.edit: GET /lists/{id}/edit: field labelled "Name" pre-filled; button "Save". Success -> /lists/{id}.
ui.validation: Invalid input re-displays the form with an element role=alert whose text mentions the invalid field (e.g. "name"); nothing is created or changed.

criteria.when: they sign up at /signup with a name, a new email and a password of at least 8 characters
criteria.then: they end on /lists showing "My lists" and are signed in ("Sign out" visible)

criteria.when: she signs in at /login with the correct password; separately, with a wrong password
criteria.then: correct -> /lists; wrong -> stays on /login with a role=alert element containing "Invalid" and is not signed in
they land on / and a subsequent GET /lists no longer shows their lists (redirect to /login)

criteria.when: they create a list with a valid name (1-100 characters) at /lists/new
criteria.then: they land on /lists/{id} whose h1 is the name, and /lists shows a link with that name to /lists/{id}

criteria.when: they submit an empty name or a name longer than 100 characters
criteria.then: nothing is created or changed and the form shows a role=alert element mentioning "name"; a name of exactly 100 characters is accepted
/lists/{id} shows the new name, also after a reload and after signing out and in again
they land on /lists, the list is no longer listed, and afterwards GET /lists/{id} returns 404 for everyone, including the owner (the list is permanently removed)

criteria.given: an anonymous visitor and an existing list of alice
criteria.then: each ends on /login (redirect) or answers 401, 403 or 404; the list name is never shown

criteria.given: bob signed in and an existing list of alice
criteria.then: alice's list is not listed and both list URLs answer 403 or 404 (or redirect away) without showing the list name

criteria.given: the exact state-changing HTTP requests alice's browser sent to rename and to delete her list
criteria.when: each is re-sent unchanged (method, URL, body and non-cookie headers; any anti-forgery token taken from the replaying session) from bob's signed-in session and from an anonymous session
criteria.then: alice's list is neither renamed nor deleted (verified afterwards in alice's session)
the page shows the list name marked "Deleted" and a button "Restore list" that restores the list with its content
